scripts.text: Sorry. I am busy at the moment.
May Freyja's blessing be with you.
scripts.translation: 愿弗蕾雅的祝福与你同在。

scripts.text: Adventurer, you came. Thank you so much for taking the time while you are busy.
scripts.translation: 冒险者，你来了。百忙之中抽空前来，真的非常感谢。

scripts.text: I asked to meet you like this because I have something to ask of the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 今天特意请你来，是有件事想拜托你。

scripts.text: If it's a long request...did anything happen to the Pope?
scripts.translation: 听起来不是小事...教皇出什么事了吗？

scripts.text: First of all, forgive me for giving you the request.
scripts.translation: 先请原谅我提出这个请求。

scripts.text: Regarding the Pope, it is strictly forbidden to make any public announcement except that it is permitted to be revealed in the temple. It is a felony punishment for anyone who speaks or hears.
scripts.translation: 关于教皇的事，除了可以在神殿内公开外，严禁对外透露。无论是泄露消息还是听闻此事，都将受到严厉惩罚。

scripts.text: However, even if this is the situation and the adventurer sees me as a reliable person, listen to what I have to say from now on, and whether you accept the request or not, you must keep today's dialogue absolutely confidential.
scripts.translation: 即使如此，既然冒险者愿意信任我，请听我接下来的话。无论你是否接受委托，都必须对今天的谈话绝对保密。

scripts.text: After all, I think you are trustworthy, so I will trust you and tell you.
scripts.translation: 我相信你，所以还是说吧。

scripts.text: As the adventurer speculates, a small problem recently occurred with the Pope.
scripts.translation: 正如你猜的，教皇最近确实出了些状况。

scripts.text: ^0000cdPope's sleeping time^000000 is abnormal, and it is increasing more and more.
scripts.translation: ^0000cd教皇的睡眠时间^000000异常，而且越来越长。

scripts.text: At first, she started to go to bed early in the evening, then she started to get up much later in the morning, and now she goes to bed more often.
scripts.translation: 起初，她开始晚上很早睡觉，然后早上起床越来越晚，现在更是频繁地入睡。

scripts.text: Is there something wrong with her health?
It's not like that. We also tried all kinds of tests, thinking that the Pope's health might have been abnormal, but the physical condition was extremely good except for falling asleep all the time.
scripts.translation: 不是那样的。我们也怀疑教皇的健康出了问题，做了各种检查，但除了总是睡着之外，她的身体状况非常好。

scripts.text: After waking up, she has a sad expression, often immersed in other thoughts, and shows a loss of concentration. And she just goes back to sleep.
scripts.translation: 醒来后，她总是神情悲伤，常常陷入沉思，显得心不在焉。随后又会睡着。

scripts.text: As the situation continues like this, words of mouth are starting to spread out little by little even inside the temple.
scripts.translation: 这样下去，连神殿内部都开始渐渐传出流言。

scripts.text: If it's not her health, what is the problem?
scripts.translation: 如果不是健康问题，那问题出在哪里？

scripts.text: It must be a psychological issue. In my opinion, it seems to be connected to what she sees in her ^0000cdDreams^000000.
scripts.translation: 应该是心里的问题，我怀疑与她在^0000cd梦境^000000中看到的东西有关。

scripts.text: Just once, she woke up and asked about her ^0000cdbrother Luwmin^000000.
scripts.translation: 有一次，她醒来后问起了^0000cd哥哥卢明^000000。

scripts.text: So the Pope has a family...?
Yes. However, it is a matter of our religion that before coming to the temple and becoming a Pope, everything must be washed away and forgotten.
scripts.translation: 是的。不过按照教义，进入神殿并成为教皇之前的一切，都必须洗净并遗忘。

scripts.text: This includes any connection to families.
scripts.translation: 这包括与家人的所有联系。

scripts.text: It is a once in a life chance: born as a child of choice and entering the temple to be reborn as a body to enshrine the goddess.
scripts.translation: 生来便是天选之子，进入神殿，重生为迎接女神的容器，这是仅有一次的机会。

scripts.text: So, officially, the Pope has no secular family.
scripts.translation: 因此，按神殿的说法，教皇没有世俗中的家人。

scripts.text: When the Pope, who knows that fact, asks about her family's affairs after dreaming, it means she's seeing something in her dreams.
scripts.translation: 她明知这一点，醒来后却仍问起家人的事，恐怕是在梦中看到了什么。

scripts.text: But it's just a dream, isn't it?
Yes, it's just a dream, of course, but I don't see it that way. And that's why we enlisted adventurers.
scripts.translation: 是的，那当然只是梦，但我并不这么认为。所以我们才请来了冒险者。

scripts.text: The Pope is not allowed to touch anyone in the temple, and if someone had to approach the Pope, this person would have to bribe someone within the temple or use another method.
scripts.translation: 教皇不允许触碰神殿里的任何人。如果有人必须接近教皇，就得贿赂神殿中的人，或另想办法。

scripts.text: However, that method is rather unlikely due to the high probability of getting caught.
scripts.translation: 然而，由于被发现的概率很高，这种方法的可能性较小。

scripts.text: The only way to get in touch without getting anyone else's suspicions is to dream. It seems that someone is breaking through the surveillance and interfering with the Pope's dream.
scripts.translation: 要在不引起他人怀疑的情况下接触教皇，唯一的办法就是进入梦境。似乎有人绕过了监视，正在干扰教皇的梦。

scripts.text: It cannot be confirmed, but it is possible.
scripts.translation: 无法确认，但这是可能的。

scripts.text: And there is one, someone who has doubts.
scripts.translation: 而且，确实有一个可疑的人。

scripts.text: The Pope's ^0000cdtwin brother^000000, who was sealed in ice by ^0000ffKthullanax^000000 in the depths of the ^0000ffIce Cave^000000.
According to a recent investigation report, it was due to the influence of Kthullanax that it was given a weak magical power.
scripts.translation: 最近的调查报告指出，他受到寒冰龙的影响，获得了微弱的魔力。

scripts.text: In one instance, there must be a special connection as the twins born at one day and at one o'clock.
scripts.translation: 双胞胎同年同月同日、同一时刻出生，或许存在特殊的联系。

scripts.text: If somehow, through a dream, consciousness came into contact with the Pope, it would be possible to intervene in everything about the Pope through a dream.
scripts.translation: 如果他的意识通过梦境接触了教皇，也许就能借梦境影响她的一切。
甚至连本人都没有意识到。

scripts.text: As the current Pope's sleep time is getting slower, it is speculated that someone is trying to hold onto her or that the Pope does not want to wake herself up.
scripts.translation: 教皇睡得越来越久，可能是有人想留住她，也可能是她自己不愿醒来。

scripts.text: So I hope you can get into the Pope's dream and see what's going on, and if you find any problems, you can solve them.
scripts.translation: 所以想请你进入教皇的梦，查明情况，发现问题就设法解决。

scripts.text: But how do you get into someone else's dream?
scripts.translation: 但是，要怎么进入别人的梦境呢？

scripts.text: It is possible through a ^0000cdspecial device^000000 that crosses the dreams.
scripts.translation: 可以通过一种^0000cd特殊装置^000000来跨越梦境。

scripts.text: But why do I have to go, not the temple officials?
scripts.translation: 可为什么找我，不让神殿里的人去？

scripts.text: I can't give you more details, but the situation in Arunafelz is not very good, especially inside the temple.
scripts.translation: 我无法透露更多细节，但阿鲁纳菲兹的情况并不乐观，尤其是神殿内部。

scripts.text: It is a situation in which the current state of the Pope may be politically exploited.
scripts.translation: 教皇现在的状况，很可能被人当作政治斗争的工具。

scripts.text: That's why the Pope secretly enlisted the adventurer after trying to find someone who was open to both sides and was reliable.
scripts.translation: 因此，只能秘密寻找与双方都能打交道、又值得信任的人，最后请来了你。

scripts.text: I was inevitably asked to do this because I had to keep my position and take care of the Pope.
scripts.translation: 我还得守住自己的位置，照顾教皇，实在不得已才提出这个请求。

scripts.text: The Pope is Arunafelz's hope and dream.
scripts.translation: 教皇是阿鲁纳菲兹的希望与梦想。

scripts.text: If her dreaming duration continually increase, then one day she won't wake up and sleep forever...
scripts.translation: 如果她的睡眠时间持续增加，总有一天她会再也无法醒来，陷入永恒的沉睡...

scripts.text: Protect the Pope in your dreams and go as far as possible to find out what's going on.
scripts.translation: 请在梦境中保护教皇，并尽可能深入，查明那里发生了什么。

scripts.text: However, as it is a dream, I do not know what there might be. No one knows what the Pope will show or how she will react.
scripts.translation: 不过那毕竟是梦，我也不知道里面会有什么。谁也不知道教皇会展现什么，或会作何反应。

scripts.text: Maybe it's really dangerous. So please be careful.
scripts.translation: 那里可能真的非常危险。所以请务必小心。

scripts.text: Would you like to enter her dream right now? Or do you need time to prepare?
scripts.translation: 你想现在进入她的梦境吗？还是需要时间准备？

scripts.text: Okay. Then, please prepare yourself and speak to me again when you are ready to walk your dream path.
scripts.translation: 好，先做好准备吧，等能踏上梦之路时再来找我。

scripts.text: Adventurer, what was the Pope's dream state like?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，教皇的梦里是什么情形？

scripts.text: - You describe the dream of the Pope and Luwmin in detail -
scripts.translation: - 你详细描述了教皇和卢明的梦境 -

scripts.text: That's bizzare. So you found out that her dream was due to her anxiety in daily life?
scripts.translation: 真奇怪...也就是说，那些梦是她平时的焦虑造成的？

scripts.text: I'm sure she came to her senses.
scripts.translation: 我相信她已经清醒过来了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, do you mind if I were to ask for another favour?
scripts.translation: 冒险者，我可以再麻烦你一件事吗？

scripts.text: Could you accompany the Pope in her dream again? She...needs company.
scripts.translation: 你能再次陪伴教皇进入她的梦境吗？她...需要陪伴。

scripts.text: Sure. I've also promised that to the Pope herself.
scripts.translation: 当然。我也已经答应过教皇本人了。

scripts.text: Thank you very much. She is haunted by her inner demons...
scripts.translation: 谢谢，她一直被心魔困扰着...

scripts.text: As for today, it's time for you to relax comfortably.
...I don't think that this is right.
You should form a party first before we proceed any further.
scripts.translation: 在继续之前，你们应该先组成队伍。

scripts.text: Recently, the Pope began to have long dreams. And they got longer as days went by.
scripts.translation: 最近教皇的梦越来越长，一天比一天更难醒来。

scripts.text: Maybe by entering her dream, we could identify the cause behind it and resolve it safely.
scripts.translation: 也许通过进入她的梦境，我们可以找到原因并安全地解决它。

scripts.text: I will enter the Pope's dreams.
The Pope has yet to fall into slumber.
^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空间旅行的痕迹已经消失。你现在可以在次元之间移动了。^000000

scripts.text: The crack in time is not safe enough to pass back and forth. Please come back again when the after effect timer has passed.
scripts.translation: 时间裂隙目前还不够稳定，无法往返通行。请等副作用计时结束后再来。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空间旅行的痕迹已经消失。你现在可以在次元之间移动了。^000000

scripts.text: Hello, I am a pathway to dreams. How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 你好，我是通往梦境的道路。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Okay, I got it. Please come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了。如果您改变主意，请随时回来。

scripts.text: The passage is not activated yet.

scripts.translation: 我会打开通往梦境的路。

scripts.text: I hope you have a pleasant dream.
Pope, please calm down. I have been sent by Niren.
scripts.translation: 教皇，请冷静。我是尼伦派来的。

scripts.text: Niren has been busy for a while and sent me instead.
scripts.translation: 尼伦最近很忙，所以派我来了。
是啊...我想起来了。冒险者...

scripts.text: Tilibi ... is gone. No matter how much I searched...
scripts.translation: 蒂利比...不见了。无论我怎么找...

scripts.text: Niren gave the doll to me. I had it just a little while ago.
scripts.translation: 是尼伦送我的玩偶，刚刚还在身边。

scripts.text: I think I lost the doll here.
scripts.translation: 我想我是把玩偶弄丢在这里了。

scripts.text: It's okay. You'll be able to find it.
It's outside of the temple ... But it does not look like Tilibi.
scripts.translation: 约在神殿外面...可是还没找到蒂利比。

scripts.text: It's too late to find Tilibi.
scripts.translation: 现在找蒂利比已经太晚了。

scripts.text: Tilbi does not seem to be here, so how about looking for it elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 蒂利比似乎不在这里，我们要不要去别处找找？

scripts.text: Your name, what was it again?
Come on, let us go together.
It is also a blasphemy of Freyja to not honour one's time. Please act with discretion.
scripts.translation: 不守时也是对弗蕾雅的大不敬。请自重。

scripts.text: Pope, please behave yourself in public.
scripts.translation: 教皇陛下，请在公众场合注意言行。

scripts.text: What a disrespect to the Pope! Take a look at yourself!
scripts.translation: 这不是有辱教皇的身份吗！看看你现在的样子！

scripts.text: The Pope is divine! Let's keep that ideal. Don't speak up!
scripts.translation: 教皇是神圣的，必须维持这份神圣！不许多嘴！

scripts.text: The pope is a vessel for the Goddess, who will one day rise. Isn't it natural that the Avatar should be clean?
scripts.translation: 教皇陛下是女神的容器，女神终将降临。化身保持洁净，难道不是理所当然的吗？

scripts.text: Stop the ruckus! The Pope is the one who gives us joy and hope, just by her being!
scripts.translation: 别闹了！教皇陛下的存在本身就给我们带来了喜悦和希望！

scripts.text: A promise? The Pope should not leave the temple.
scripts.translation: 约定？教皇不应该离开神殿。

scripts.text: She should not be in contact with outsiders!
scripts.translation: 她不应该与外界的人接触！

scripts.text: Pope can only meet people who are authorized in the temple.
scripts.translation: 教皇陛下只能见神殿中获授权的人。

scripts.text: The Pope will need to act according to our objectives.
scripts.translation: 教皇必须按我们的意愿行动。

scripts.text: The Pope's actions are none of your concern.
scripts.translation: 教皇陛下的行为与你们无关。
如果你不同意，就退位吧。

scripts.text: Quiet! You dare to disobey us?
Please listen to me. You should stop whatever you're doing!
scripts.translation: 听我说，立刻停下你正在做的事！

scripts.text: However, it is true that the current Pope lacks qualities.
scripts.translation: 不过，现任教皇确实不够格。

scripts.text: If she's not enough, we can swap her out. Isn't there another perfect candidate?
scripts.translation: 如果她不够格，我们可以换人。难道没有另一个完美的人选吗？

scripts.text: The second Avatar, born at the same time...!
scripts.translation: 不是还有同时降生的另一个化身吗...！

scripts.text: We may have made the wrong choice.
If I had to change my choice right now...!
scripts.translation: 如果现在让我重新选择...！

scripts.text: The imperfect Pope needs to be replaced.
scripts.translation: 不够完美的教皇，就得换掉。

scripts.text: I need a Pope who listens to my concerns.
scripts.translation: 我需要一位能倾听我诉求的教皇。

scripts.text: We don't need the current Pope.
Don't stand still Pope, and make a stand!
scripts.translation: 教皇，别光站着，拿出态度来！

scripts.text: Pope, Pope! Get the hang of it!!
What am I... to these people?
scripts.translation: 我对于这些人...意味着什么？

scripts.text: A sacred vessel of the Goddess.
I was the result of a wrong decision.
I didn't have any qualifications from the beginning.
scripts.translation: 我一开始就不具备资格。

scripts.text: But this is not what I want.
Pope, calm down. This is all a dream.
scripts.translation: 教皇，冷静，这一切都是梦。

scripts.text: Your anxiety distorts the dream. Outside the dream, everyone awaits you as the Pope!
scripts.translation: 你的焦虑扭曲了梦境，现实里大家都在等你回去！

scripts.text: But... I... I've made a promise.
scripts.translation: 但是...我...我已经许下诺言了。

scripts.text: I have an appointment. I have to meet.
Come on, we have to get out of here.

scripts.translation: 教皇，请不要离开您的座位！

scripts.text: This is where the Pope should remain!
scripts.translation: 这里才是教皇该待的地方！
其实根本没有人需要我！

scripts.text: I do not have a place here!
scripts.translation: 我在这个地方没有容身之处！

scripts.text: Pope! Please remain seated, for your own good!
scripts.translation: 教皇！为了您好，请留在座位上！

scripts.text: All of you, restrain the Pope!
Certainly, Pope. Please stand behind me.
scripts.translation: 当然，教皇。请站在我身后。

scripts.text: A boy with white hair and a pale complexion appeared.
scripts.translation: 一个白发、面色苍白的男孩出现了。

scripts.text: [This boy seems to be Luwmin that High Priestess Niren mentioned.]
scripts.translation: [这个男孩似乎就是大祭司尼伦提到的卢明。]

scripts.text: I heard you crying, hence I came here to check on you.
scripts.translation: 我听到你在哭，所以过来看看你。
你没事吧？发生什么事了？

scripts.text: Yes. I'm okay now. The adventurers helped me.
scripts.translation: 没事。我现在没事了。冒险者帮了我。

scripts.text: Thank you for helping my sister. I'll take it from here.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你帮助我的妹妹。接下来的事交给我吧。

scripts.text: I'm in charge of the Pope's welfare until she returns back here safely.
scripts.translation: 在教皇平安回来之前，由我负责照顾她。

scripts.text: These clothes attract attention. Lets get you a change of attire.
scripts.translation: 这身衣服太引人注目了。我们给你换身衣服吧。
普通孩子平时...就穿这样的衣服。

scripts.text: Let's go now. Mom and Dad are waiting.
scripts.translation: 走吧。爸爸妈妈在等着我们。
哥哥，这里就是那个地方...？

scripts.text: It's okay now. We are safe.
scripts.translation: 现在没事了。我们安全了。

scripts.text: The place of dreams that we always talked about? How?
scripts.translation: 我们一直谈论的那个梦境之地？怎么做到的？

scripts.text: I wish, I wished. I wanted to make my dream into reality.
scripts.translation: 我许了愿，一直许愿，想让梦想成为现实。

scripts.text: I thought this was a place that existed only in dreams.
scripts.translation: 我以为这里只存在于梦中。

scripts.text: This fountain is the same as I imagined. That tree too. And... that doll!
scripts.translation: 这座喷泉和我想象的一样。那棵树也是。还有...那个玩偶！

scripts.text: If we're hiding in here. Nobody can find us.
scripts.translation: 只要躲在这里，就没人找得到我们。

scripts.text: No one can ever find us?
scripts.translation: 真的没人能找到我们吗？

scripts.text: Yes, you can send that adventurer back now.
scripts.translation: 是的，现在你可以把那个冒险者送走了。

scripts.text: They are no longer needed as we are now safe.
scripts.translation: 现在安全了，不需要他了。

scripts.text: I will stay with the Pope until the end.
scripts.translation: 我会一直陪伴教皇，直到最后。

scripts.text: Keep her safe from what? We were fine until you came!
scripts.translation: 有什么可保护的？你来之前，我们明明好好的！

scripts.text: After you appeared, we had high priests and guards coming for us.... We even got separated from our parents!!
scripts.translation: 自从你出现后，就有神官和卫兵来找我们...我们甚至和父母走散了！！

scripts.text: You are a risk to us!
Brother, don't say that. The Adventurer has been a trustful companion.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，别这么说。这位冒险者一直是值得信赖的伙伴。

scripts.text: Really? Are you for real? Even though everyone out there betrayed us?
scripts.translation: 真的吗？外面的人都背叛了我们，你还当真信他？

scripts.text: Yes. I believe in the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 是的。我相信这位冒险者。

scripts.text: I thought this place was just for the two of us...now this?
scripts.translation: 我以为这里只有我们两个...可现在呢？

scripts.text: You think that this adventurer could protect you better than I could?
scripts.translation: 你觉得这位冒险者能比我更好地保护你吗？

scripts.text: We will be hidden here forever. Free from the priests, guards... even mom and dad.
scripts.translation: 我们将永远躲在这里。远离神官、卫兵...甚至爸爸妈妈。

scripts.text: ... Nobody will ever find us! I would bet my life on that..!
scripts.translation: ...真的不会有人找到我们！我敢拿性命发誓...！

scripts.text: Pope! You cannot stay here forever, you need to wake up eventually!
scripts.translation: 教皇！你不能永远留在这里，你终究要醒来的！

scripts.text: In reality, many people are awaiting your presence. This is just a dream which may not reflect what have happened in the past.
scripts.translation: 现实中有很多人在等你。这只是一场梦，未必会呈现过去实际发生的事。

scripts.text: Do not listen to him! It's all a lie!
Yes, that's right. This is just a dream. It's a manifestation of all of your anxiety and Luwmin's. Not everything you saw was real.
scripts.translation: 没错，这只是一场梦。它呈现的是你和卢明的所有焦虑。你看到的并非全都是真实的。

scripts.text: A lie! It's all a lie!!
I lost Tilibi in the darkness, and...then, I met the adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我在黑暗中失去了蒂利比，然后...我遇见了那位冒险者。

scripts.text: Your anxiety has been terribly distorted in this dream.
scripts.translation: 你的焦虑在这梦中被严重扭曲了。

scripts.text: Don't listen to that. Don't even think about that!
scripts.translation: 别听他的，也不许想那些！

scripts.text: Those people weren't your real parents...
scripts.translation: 那些人并不是你真正的父母...

scripts.text: I... I need to go back there...
You want to go back? You can stay here forever without the interference from others. You told me life outside is...suffocating.
scripts.translation: 你想回去？你可以永远留在这里，不受他人打扰。你曾告诉我，外面的生活...令人窒息。

scripts.text: I can withstand it brother. I can withstand it.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，我能撑下去，能撑下去的。

scripts.text: Don't do that. Luwmin is frozen and can not move.
scripts.translation: 别那样做。卢明被冻结了，无法动弹。

scripts.text: Before coming here, I was told by Niren.
scripts.translation: 在来这里之前，尼伦告诉过我。

scripts.text: That the Pope's twin brother, Luwmin, was sealed in the depths of the Ice Cave.
scripts.translation: 教皇的双胞胎哥哥卢明，被封印在冰洞深处。

scripts.text: What do you know...! People are evil to the core! We never had a choice!
scripts.translation: 你懂什么...！人们骨子里都是邪恶的！我们从未有过选择！

scripts.text: Just because we were born with this appearance, we were snatched to the temple. I was imprisoned in ice for this very reason!
scripts.translation: 仅仅因为我们生来就是这副模样，就被抓进了神殿。我正是因为这个原因才被冰封的！

scripts.text: We didn't even receive a proper explanation!
scripts.translation: 他们甚至没有给我们一个合理的解释！

scripts.text: Why was I even born into such a fate in the first place...
scripts.translation: 我究竟为何会生来背负这样的命运...
封印？我的哥哥...被封印了？

scripts.text: It doesn't matter now. We will always be together from now on.
scripts.translation: 现在说这些已经没意义了。从今往后，我们将永远在一起。

scripts.text: That was a long time ago...
Seal ... Ice Cave ... It's cold now.
scripts.translation: 封印...冰洞...现在一定很冷。

scripts.text: What do you dream of now, brother?
scripts.translation: 哥哥，你现在做着什么梦？

scripts.text: Is that why my brother wants to share a dream with me?
scripts.translation: 所以，哥哥才想和我做同一个梦？

scripts.text: What do you want to dream about?
The annoying adventurer will soon be gone!!!!
scripts.translation: 那个讨厌的冒险者马上就要消失了！！！！
